items.title: Mr. Arvind G D
items.qualifications: M.Sc. Anaesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology, B.Sc. Anaesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology
items.position: Assistant Professor, MS Ramaiah College of Allied Health Sciences, Bengaluru, Karnataka
items.bio: Arvind G D is an Assistant Professor in Anaesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology with an M.Sc. in OT & AT. He has experience in academic teaching, clinical instruction, student mentoring, curriculum-related activities and research. His academic and research work includes postoperative pain management, perioperative care and clinical education. He has also presented research at conferences and has experience mentoring students in academic and scientific presentations.
